meta.event: Return to Running - Aerobic Base Rebuild (no race scheduled yet)

currentForm.consistency: Very consistent Apr-Jun 2026 (3x/week, long run built 6km->12km). Then an 8-9 week break from running (Jun 30-Aug 30, 2026) due to a busy work stretch covering for colleagues plus planned PTO -- only light, easy cycling since. Not injury-related.

strengths.evidence: Built long run from 6km to 12km over 8 weeks (Apr-Jun 2026) with good consistency

limiters.evidence: 8-9 week layoff means partial aerobic detraining; restart should be gradual
Beginner to structured strength training -- starting with foundation-level bodyweight work
Strava activity history shows a lower-leg (shin) issue and recovery block in Aug 2025 -- worth keeping mileage increases conservative to avoid recurrence

constraints: 3 running days/week available: Tuesday, Friday, Sunday (long run)
Wants to add gym strength training as a beginner
Last 'easy run' on Strava (Jun 30) spent 78.5% of time in Zone 3 (Tempo) instead of Zone 2 -- deliberately keeping HR ceiling low this block to correct that pattern

pace.source: Strava RacePace zones (from a 35:00 5K best effort) -- likely stale post-break; treat as reference only, not a hard target, until you retest

run.note: For this whole 6-week block, run by HR/feel (Zone 1-2, HR under ~156bpm) rather than chasing these paces -- they were set before the break and may feel harder than expected right now.

phases.name: Return to Run
phases.focus: Rebuild running consistency safely after the 8-9 week break, before adding any real load
physiologicalGoals: Let tendons/bones re-adapt to running load gradually

phases.name: Aerobic Base Rebuild
phases.focus: Progress volume back toward pre-break peak, introduce light strides, cement the strength habit
physiologicalGoals: Restore prior aerobic capacity (back to 12km long run)
Prepare a base for future speed work

weeks.focus: Easy Run x2 + Long Run (easy), 13.0km running + 2 strength sessions

workouts.name: Beginner Full-Body Strength
workouts.description: Bodyweight foundation session #1-2: focus on learning the movements with good form, light effort.
workouts.humanReadable:
Warm-up: 5min light cardio + dynamic stretches
Circuit (2-3 rounds):
  - Bodyweight squats x 12-15
  - Push-ups (knee or full) x 10-12
  - Glute bridges x 12-15
  - Standing single-leg balance reach x 8 each side
Core finisher: Plank 3x30-45s, Dead bug 2x10 each side
Cool-down: 5min stretching

workouts.name: Easy Run
workouts.description: Very easy, conversational the whole way. Walk breaks are completely fine if HR creeps toward 156bpm — the only goal this week is rebuilding the habit, not pace.
workouts.humanReadable:
